t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Njimé ntiesé Atta Obasi, bré Wéh oturéme sé nding Wah na nyubé Wah. Méh nwoh otti kah njgimé nyih, kah ogong ohomé na kah ikonm Effah, kah okpagk ohomé nah kah effonome Obah. Kpeh Obasi ettat chang bréh Wéh, nyoh anyangané Kpekpe nah Nfonéh arringeh Bejih Ebéh.
